title: Supreme Court: Lender With Pervasive Control Over Borrower Is a Related Party, Cannot Sit on CoC
case_name: ECL Finance Ltd. & Anr. v. Abhinav Mukherjee & Ors. (Committee of Creditors of Palm Developers Pvt. Ltd.)
card_summary: The Supreme Court dismissed appeals by ECL Finance Ltd. and its debenture trustee IDBI Trusteeship Services Ltd. against their exclusion from the CoC of Palm Developers Pvt. Ltd. ECL had taken an active role in steering the borrower's business and policy decisions, making it a related party, and the trustee was held equally ineligible. Complete control over the debtor is not required for this disqualification.
card_tip: Structured lenders who take board or policy-level control as part of their security package risk being treated as related-party creditors and shut out of the CoC in any later insolvency.
verification_notes: Case number and bench confirmed via LiveLawBiz and Law Trend reports, both filed the same week; neither report gives a formal neutral citation for the Supreme Court judgment itself, so citation is stated as the civil appeal number reported.
